g.text: 1 · One rig. The gate CTA swaps rail + data content in place. Geometry, yaw, grab bar and the
bottom-bar standard (Back cx 69/w 90 · Next cx 321/w 150 · cy 402 · 11 pt) are untouched.
2 · Rail. 7 entries 184 × 44 @ 52 pitch. Short labels on the rail, full step titles in the data header
(a selector never relabels itself). Sequential unlock · visited = tick, revisitable via Back · locked = dim + lock.
3 · Quit. On step 1 the Back slot reads "Quit" → confirm modal (existing cancel modal) → back to
Intro, run + timer cancelled. From Intro, Back returns to the passport tabs.
4 · Next gating. Locked until every task circle on the step is ticked. Completing a step plays that
step's removal on the stage (DisassemblyAnimator — never bespoke), records the split, then advances.
5 · Timer invisible. Runs from Start, splits per step — never shown live (time is an achievement,
not pressure; a live clock would contaminate the study). Total + splits appear only on Summary.
6 · Stage in steps. No idle spin; current parts full colour + highlight, rest dimmed (3-name MPB write),
removed parts hidden. Padlock/FREE disabled during steps 1–5 (LINKED only) — smallest safe scope.
7 · No drag-out. RB2_0's action-zone part dragging is not ported: the physical unit is the task,
the stage is guidance. Model picks stay inert in this mode.
8 · Retirement. On approval + device pass, menu 05/06/07 flat screens leave the router;
deep deletion stays post-study per the retirement plan.

svg.text: Data shown is the live payload (steps, actions, gold value-flags, part groups) and spec-09 demo splits · mock 10_v1 · drafts/10_v1_disassembly_mode.svg
